messages:
Nia: quick heads-up 1: Hyperspine EAP confirmed. Partner wants a tight benchmark window + minimal telemetry. Need NDA tweaks and a bench matrix. Who owns legal?

Carlos: I can take NDA. Partner requires no raw prompt capture and mentions 'hashed IDs ok'. Will add explicit 45-day retention and KMS encryption. Draft in ~3h.

Eve: Lab availability: 5/25/6 (UTC). We'll allocate 3x HSP-80 nodes (partner image) and one control node. Plan: perf sweep, stability soak, and p99 tail latency sampling.

Jordan: For workloads, propose: mem-heavy seq=4096, chat-like seq=2048 with turns, and embeddings stability. Use `bench_runner --model=redwood-13b --threads=4 --seq=4096 --samples=200`. Capture `gpu_memory_mb` and `kv_hit_rate`.

Riley: Marketplace ops: partner needs approved logo, short joint blurb, and a 2-sentence partner quote. Also confirm co-hosted webinar windows. I'll draft blurb + ask comms for quote template.

Nia: Telemetry constraints: partner wants only aggregated counters and encrypted hashes. No prompt-level logs. OpsBot, record checklist link.

OpsBot: checklist uploaded: `drive.redwood.com/hyperspine/eap-checklist-v2.md`. Contains telemetry schema, bench matrix, and repro scripts.

Carlos: NDA clause: "Only aggregated metrics and cryptographic hashes of request IDs may be exchanged; raw prompt/response content prohibited. Artifacts retained for 45 days, stored with KMS." Will attach version when ready.

Eve: Note on caches: measure cold (cache disabled) and warm (cache enabled). Suggested flags: `--cache=off` and `--cache=on`. Log `kv_hit_rate` and `cache_fill_seconds`.

Jordan: Sample output from a pre-run: ```json
{"model":"redwood-13b","seq":2048,"p50_ms":34.1,"p95_ms":112.6,"gpu_util_pct":78.3}
``` Save artifacts as `hsp_eap_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Riley: Timelines: NDA by Carlos end-of-day, perf run by 5/4, marketplace blurb by 5/8, partner quote by 5/10. Tentative soft-launch 5/20 if results look clean.

Nia: Action recap: (1) Carlos -> NDA draft; (2) Eve/Jordan -> bench runs + upload; (3) Riley -> comms + logo follow-up; (4) OpsBot -> maintain checklist and telemetry schema. Sync Wed 10am UTC to review artifacts.

Carlos: pinging legal for a quick sign-off thread after draft.

Eve: I'll include a short runbook in the artifacts with exact commands and env. Will tag here when uploaded. :rocket:

Nia: thanks all 1: keeping convo here for EAP ops and partner comms.
